main_text.p:
Donec blandiíus, fabellifque admirandis
De laruis, deque empufis, & lumine caffis
Tandem captiuum trahat in fua retia pifcem.

Adde his quos febris, quos vexat dira phrenefis,
Aut alius cerebri expugnator morbus: in ipfa
Morte fiti, cùm iam medicus fpondere falutem
Defierit, longa ftolidi vertigine turans
Se, (quodcunque aui placatis numinis ira
Iam deplorata dignetur iungere vita)
In Franciscano vitluros effe cucullo.

Hic aliquis sancta pietate Paterculus ardens
Protinus inferni fuscam cum cannabe veftem,
Et caput exfcalpit cerebrofum, & fomnia blanda
Garrit in auriculam, meritorum mille trecentos
Promittit modios, venias inculcat, olympum
Defuncto fpondet, visuo fpondere paratus,
Captiat e potius quàm vel feminuncia prade
Una breuis pereat. Tum fpe laetatus inani
Interea miser agrotus subet optima quaque
Deferri ad monachos, argenteá vasa, tapetas,
Molliculas vestes, & quicquid venditur auro,
Quatenus aut illis nudos fas tangere nummos.

Verùm hæc pinguiculis tenduntur retia turdis,
His cœlum venale patet: si Codrus & Irus
Pauper obit, ceffat pietas, non cymbala clangunt,
Nænia nulla fonat, ferie nec candida longa
Pompa praeit, nullo planguntur funera luctu.

Sed nec Fumigera minor est accessio turba,
Cùm mens vefano inflammata cupidine vultum
Affingit fpernentis opes, vilique paratu,
Inceffúque graui, & fiëta probitate loquendi
Seducit ftolidam pietatis imagine plebem.

page.notes: Marginal marks and specks at the margins are not printed text. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the scan quality, notably "Tandem captiuum", "fpondere" and "Nænia"; read as printed. Line breaks in verse are marked with br.
